<thought>The observed [M+H]+ ion at m/z 114.068 suggests a neutral mass of ~113.060 Da. The isotopic pattern (≈6.7 % M+1) indicates about six carbons. Solving 6 C + x H + y O = 113.060 gives a best fit of C₆H₉O₂ (neutral mass 113.0603 Da), which matches the measured ion within ~0.5 mDa. Therefore the molecular formula is C6H9O2.</thought>
<final_answer>C6H9O2</final_answer>
